result.title: Beyond Causal Masks: Auditing and Localizing Hidden Future-Token Leakage in Adaptive Sequence Models
result.summary: Hidden future-token leakage can create false architectural gains: an autoregressive model may appear substantially better under teacher-forced evaluation while its free-running generation deteriorates. We investigate this failure in an adaptive residual-routing decoder whose sequence-level routing summary exposes prefix positions to future tokens despite a correct causal attention mask. An anomalous 24-layer checkpoint reduces validation loss from the baseline's 3.5958 to 1.4259, yet it fails a prefix-invariance audit and has substantially higher reference-model perplexity during generation. Layer-wise diagnostics and implementation inspection trace the violation to a full-sequence summary broadcast through the dynamic routing-query path. Two independently trained 12-layer causal repairs eliminate detectable leakage and return validation loss and reference perplexity to the control scale, removing the large apparent advantage. As diagnostic tools, we use the established prefix-invariance contract, maximum prefix-output discrepancy (LeakScore), complementary behavioral metrics, and layer-wise profiles. Supporting experiments cover six synthetic implementation pairs spanning five module families, clean pretrained controls, controlled fault injection, and cache consistency across numerical precisions. These results illustrate how hidden future-token access can produce misleading claims of architectural progress and why lower teacher-forced loss should be interpreted together with whole-model causal checks and free-running evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文审计自适应残差路由解码器中隐藏的未来 token 泄漏：虽然因果注意力掩码正确，但序列级路由摘要把前缀位置暴露给未来 token，使 24 层模型验证损失从 3.5958 虚降至 1.4259 却在自由生成时变差；作者用前缀不变性审计、最大前缀输出差异（LeakScore）与逐层诊断定位到动态路由 query 路径的全序列摘要广播，并以两个独立训练的 12 层修复版本消除泄漏。
AI.relevance_reason: 其前缀不变性契约、LeakScore、缓存一致性与 teacher-forcing／自由生成对照的审计思路，可能可供核查 LVR 或 VLM 推理中 latent 状态是否偷看未来信息、表面收益是否源自信息泄漏而非真实推理。
